plan: [This is a single-round second-price sealed-bid auction with independent private values. In such auctions, bidding your true value is a dominant strategy: it maximizes expected payoff regardless of others' strategies and avoids winning at a price above your value. With my private value of $30 and rational opponents, bidding $30 is optimal (ties resolved randomly but truthful bidding remains best). I will therefore bid my value exactly to maximize long-run profit.]
